svg.title: Limen architecture on AWS
svg.desc: People and CI bots log in through an identity provider, connect through one public NLB to Limen proxies, and reach targets through outbound-only worker tunnels. Every session is audited to S3.

text.tspan: Short-lived credentials, one public entry point, outbound-only workers, and an audit trail for every session
